# photo-only-gpu

The card's test: a photo-only positive is marked so. Synthetic, the `gpu-not-stated` listing
with one brand-only GPU verdict fed through parts-record's photo seam (photo-review does not
exist yet). The GPU state is `in_photos`, the caution `photo_only` is set, coverage shows the
photos were read, the photo part is never confirmed (R5 needs a verbatim text quote), and GPU is
not an unknown.
